title: Preflight bridge notes for audit prep
content:
Daily scratch log — preflight bridge (SOC2 prep). Quick brain dump; mostly shorthand.

Context:
- Purpose: get a tight, minimal evidence set that supports common SOC2 CC and common controls for hosted + dedicated + private.
- Constraints: some customers on private deployment require KMS/HSM details, others only ask for key rotation policy and logs.
- Stakeholders: Trust Ops (me), SecEng (Eliot), Solutions (Priya), SRE (on-call).

03/10 notes (latest):
- Walked through evidence matrix w/ Eliot. High-level outcomes:
  >> baseline evidence: IAM role inventory, kube RBAC export, MFA enforcement report, KMS key list with rotation flag.
  >> desirable: automated log-forwarding proof (sample logs + query), change control PRs for prod infra, runbook for incident notification.
- Todos after sync:
  1) Produce a short script to list active service principals + when last used (INF-1245).
  2) Add a 1-page diagram of network segregation for private deployments (VPCs, transit gateways, customer-managed gateways).
  3) Collect 7-day sample of token usage by route (generation vs embedding) for cost/abuse controls.

Evidence mapping (scratch):
- CC6 (logical access):
  - evidence items: okta-auth-report.csv (exported), iam-role-export-2026-03-01.json (script outputs), mfa-enforcement-2026-02.pdf (screenshot from console).
  - owner(s): SecEng (Eliot) + SRE for runtime roles.
  - quick gaps: service account last-used attribute missing for some legacy roles. Action: script to call IAM api and annotate.

- CC7 (system operations & change mgmt):
  - evidence: GH PRs with tags 'deploy:infra', CI run logs (circleci/gha), rollback runbook draft.
  - note: need to tag a handful of PRs as examples (PRs: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/312, /330).

- CC9 (logical & physical network):
  - evidence: VPC diagrams, bastion host inventory, egress rule exports.
  - private-deploy nuance: customers run private-router, must show config snippets not screenshots. Plan: redact IPs and include config diff as text.

Risk questions to clean up (for later mailing list):
- Are there any buckets with public read set that were created before Jan 2025? (Ticket created to list and remediate)
- What is retention policy for access logs for private deployments? who owns retention?
- How do we show periodic review of vendor access (e.g., telemetry provider)? need attestation or sign-off artifacts.

Operational queries & quick examples (for evidence generation):
- kusto/logql-like pseudo queries to extract evidence (examples for SRE):
  - count by principal: "filter event=auth and status=success | summarize count() by principal"
  - recent key-rotation: "filter event=key_rotate | where timestamp > ago(90d)"
  - api-token-use: "filter route in ('/v1/generate','/v1/embeddings') | summarize tokens=sum(tokens) by route, customer_id"

Notes about KMS/HSM requirements:
- Private deployments: we need both metadata (key_ids, algorithms, rotation cadence) and proof of rotation (rotate jobs + logs).
- Hosted: cloud-managed KMS screenshots + IAM policy for KMS access.
- Action: add a short template that maps what redwood will provide vs what customer must provide.

Evidence packaging heuristics (rough):
- Minimum package per control: 1 artifact showing config + 1 artifact showing execution (logs/PR).
- Prefer text exports over screenshots where feasible. If screenshot used, include adjacent CLI export for parity.

Open items (prioritized):
- HIGH: service-account last-used tagging script (blocked on IAM read perms) >> assigned Eliot >> due 2026-03-17.
- MED: network diagram for private >> assigned me >> due 2026-03-22.
- LOW: compile sample customer redaction checklist >> assigned Priya >> due 2026-04-01.

Meeting prep checklist for next vendor audit dry run:
- 15 min: walk through evidence matrix and sample artifacts
- 10 min: demo automated script to pull access logs (one route)
- 15 min: discuss remediation timeline for legacy roles
- 10 min: confirm owners + Jira tickets

Draft email skeleton to Eng leads (for review before send):
- Subject: Preflight: evidence items we need from eng teams (quick list + owners)
- Body bullets: what we need (exports + owners + due dates), how to provide (CLI snippet or Confluence attach), contact (trust-ops slack + meeting link).

Random jots / heuristics (stashed):
- Keep evidence windows small (7–30 days) unless control requires longer.
- When in doubt, include both config + execution proof.
- Use hashed filenames for sensitive outputs (e.g., bucket-list-hash-2026-03.txt).
- For private customers, put redacted outputs in a separate evidence folder with read restrictions.

References & quick links (to paste into final doc):
- Jira: INF-1245 (service account last-use), INF-1290 (evidence packaging), TRUST-42 (private-kms-templates)
- Slack: #trust-ops, thread: thread_ts=1670023345.000200
- Confluence: Trust/Ops/Preflight-Checklist (to be updated)

End of notes — these are intentionally messy. Will clean into two artifacts: 1) short "evidence checklist" for eng leads (one-pager) and 2) a fuller "artifact pack" for auditors with redacted archives.

Quick version history:
- 2026-02-18: initial sketch (first pass of mapping)
- 2026-03-01: added KMS nuance + query examples
- 2026-03-10: synced with Eliot; action items created.

-- Heloise
